title: Krakow · Tatra Foothills and Zakopane
slogan: A 202 km loop out of Myślenice fuel
story: Mountain views, villages and traffic-aware timing. A 202 km loop that starts and ends near Myślenice, about 3 h 29 of riding. It goes by way of Chochołów wooden village, Zakopane and Gubałówka view area. The highest point is about 1,050 m. It keeps to quiet secondary roads. The plan has 1 food stop and 1 fuel stop marked.

scenicChapters.title: Polish Tatra Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 20 km this is Polish Tatra Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
